name: Covert Channel Detection
description: Ability to detect and analyse covert communication channels in network traffic. Covers DNS tunnelling, ICMP tunnelling, steganographic channels, protocol abuse (HTTP header manipulation, TLS certificate field abuse), and timing-based covert channels. Requires deep protocol knowledge and statistical analysis skills.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to covert channel detection

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the concept of covert channels and common techniques used by attackers to hide communications
evidence: Can describe common covert channel techniques (DNS tunnelling, ICMP tunnelling, steganography)
Understands why attackers use covert channels to evade detection
Can explain the difference between storage and timing covert channels

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Identifies obvious covert channels in traffic captures using known signatures and tools under supervision
evidence: Detected DNS tunnelling in PCAP files using entropy analysis and query length heuristics under guidance
Identified ICMP tunnelling by examining payload sizes and patterns
Applied IDS signatures or Zeek scripts to flag known tunnelling tools (e.g. dnscat2, iodine)
Documented covert channel findings with supervisor review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently detects covert channels using both signature-based and statistical methods in real investigations
evidence: Independently detected covert channels in 3+ real investigations
Applied entropy and statistical analysis to identify non-signature-based covert channels
Reconstructed tunnelled data from detected covert channels to recover exfiltrated content
Produced covert channel analysis reports with clear methodology and evidence

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Detects sophisticated and novel covert channels; develops detection analytics; handles timing and steganographic channels
evidence: Detected novel covert channels not matching known tool signatures
Developed detection rules or analytics for new covert channel techniques
Analysed timing-based covert channels using statistical methods
Mentors analysts on covert channel detection methodology and tooling

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines covert channel detection methodology; researches new covert communication techniques; recognised authority
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's covert channel detection methodology
Published research on covert channel detection or novel covert communication techniques
Develops detection frameworks adopted beyond the immediate team
Trains teams and presents on advanced covert channel analysis

assessment_methods.description: Analyse a PCAP file containing multiple covert channels (DNS tunnel, steganographic, and protocol abuse), detect all channels, and reconstruct tunnelled data
Given network traffic with no known signatures matching, use statistical and behavioural methods to determine whether covert channels are present
